title: thelypteris trachyphylla
intro: Thelypteris trachyphylla, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris trachyphylla are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe gastrointestinal issues, and act as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of the maidenhair fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
